question: Which material is strongly magnetic?
urdu_translation: کون سا material strongly magnetic ہے؟
A: Wood / wood
B: Iron / iron
C: Plastic / plastic
D: Glass / glass
correct_answer: B | Iron / iron

question: Which material listed in the exercise is not magnetic?
urdu_translation: exercise میں listed کون سا material magnetic نہیں ہے؟
A: Aluminium / aluminium
B: Cobalt / cobalt
C: Iron / iron
D: Nickel / nickel
correct_answer: A | Aluminium / aluminium

question: Magnetic materials can be attracted by a magnet even when they are:
urdu_translation: magnetic materials magnet سے attract ہو سکتی ہیں even when they are کیا؟
A: Not in direct contact / direct contact میں نہ ہوں
B: At absolute zero only / صرف absolute zero پر
C: Inside a liquid only / صرف liquid کے اندر
D: Without electrons / electrons کے بغیر
correct_answer: A | Not in direct contact / direct contact میں نہ ہوں

question: A magnet can be distinguished from an unmagnetised magnetic material by testing for:
urdu_translation: magnet کو unmagnetised magnetic material سے distinguish کرنے کے لیے کس effect کا test کیا جاتا ہے؟
A: Attraction only / صرف attraction
B: Heating / heating
C: Repulsion / repulsion
D: Density / density
correct_answer: C | Repulsion / repulsion

question: Every magnet has:
urdu_translation: ہر magnet کے کتنے poles ہوتے ہیں؟
A: Two poles / two poles
B: One isolated pole / one isolated pole
C: Three poles / three poles
D: No poles / no poles
correct_answer: A | Two poles / two poles

question: Like magnetic poles:
urdu_translation: like magnetic poles کیا کرتے ہیں؟
A: Attract / attract
B: Repel / repel
C: Disappear / disappear
D: Produce no field / no field produce کرتے ہیں
correct_answer: B | Repel / repel

question: Unlike magnetic poles:
urdu_translation: unlike magnetic poles کیا کرتے ہیں؟
A: Repel / repel
B: Attract / attract
C: Have zero force / zero force رکھتے ہیں
D: Become electric charges / electric charges بن جاتے ہیں
correct_answer: B | Attract / attract

question: Cutting a bar magnet into two pieces produces:
urdu_translation: bar magnet کو two pieces میں cut کرنے سے کیا produce ہوتا ہے؟
A: An isolated north pole and isolated south pole / isolated north pole اور isolated south pole
B: Two non-magnetic pieces always / always two non-magnetic pieces
C: Only one magnetic pole / صرف one magnetic pole
D: Two smaller magnets, each with north and south poles / two smaller magnets، ہر ایک کے north اور south poles
correct_answer: D | Two smaller magnets, each with north and south poles / two smaller magnets، ہر ایک کے north اور south poles

question: Induced magnetism occurs when a magnetic material becomes magnetised due to:
urdu_translation: induced magnetism کب occur ہوتی ہے؟
A: A nearby magnetic field / nearby magnetic field
B: Heating alone / صرف heating
C: Mechanical pressure only / صرف mechanical pressure
D: A temperature scale / temperature scale
correct_answer: A | A nearby magnetic field / nearby magnetic field

question: The end of an iron piece nearest a north pole becomes:
urdu_translation: north pole کے nearest iron piece کا end کیا بن جاتا ہے؟
A: A north pole / north pole
B: Electrically neutral with no magnetism / no magnetism کے ساتھ electrically neutral
C: A south pole / south pole
D: A permanent electric charge / permanent electric charge
correct_answer: C | A south pole / south pole

question: Attraction alone cannot prove that an object is a magnet because:
urdu_translation: صرف attraction object کے magnet ہونے کو prove کیوں نہیں کرتی؟
A: Magnets never attract anything / magnets کبھی کچھ attract نہیں کرتے
B: A magnet also attracts unmagnetised magnetic material / magnet unmagnetised magnetic material کو بھی attract کرتا ہے
C: Only electric charges attract / صرف electric charges attract کرتے ہیں
D: All materials repel magnets / تمام materials magnets کو repel کرتے ہیں
correct_answer: B | A magnet also attracts unmagnetised magnetic material / magnet unmagnetised magnetic material کو بھی attract کرتا ہے

question: A temporary magnet retains magnetism:
urdu_translation: temporary magnet magnetism کب retain کرتی ہے؟
A: Forever after the field is removed / field remove ہونے کے بعد forever
B: Only when heated strongly / صرف strongly heated ہونے پر
C: Mainly while the magnetising field is present / mainly magnetising field present ہونے تک
D: Without any magnetic field / کسی magnetic field کے بغیر
correct_answer: C | Mainly while the magnetising field is present / mainly magnetising field present ہونے تک

question: A permanent magnet is commonly made from:
urdu_translation: permanent magnet commonly کس material سے made ہوتی ہے؟
A: Steel / steel
B: Soft iron / soft iron
C: Wood / wood
D: Plastic / plastic
correct_answer: A | Steel / steel

question: An electromagnet normally uses a core of:
urdu_translation: electromagnet normally کس core کو use کرتی ہے؟
A: Steel for permanent retention / permanent retention کے لیے steel
B: Glass / glass
C: Aluminium only / صرف aluminium
D: Soft iron / soft iron
correct_answer: D | Soft iron / soft iron

question: Soft iron is preferred for temporary magnets because it is:
urdu_translation: temporary magnets کے لیے soft iron preferred کیوں ہے؟
A: Difficult to magnetise / difficult to magnetise
B: A perfect permanent magnet / perfect permanent magnet
C: Non-magnetic / non-magnetic
D: Easily magnetised and demagnetised / easily magnetised اور demagnetised
correct_answer: D | Easily magnetised and demagnetised / easily magnetised اور demagnetised

question: A magnetic field is the region where a magnetic object experiences:
urdu_translation: magnetic field وہ region ہے جہاں magnetic object کیا experience کرتا ہے؟
A: A magnetic force / magnetic force
B: Only heat / صرف heat
C: No interaction / no interaction
D: Only pressure / صرف pressure
correct_answer: A | A magnetic force / magnetic force

question: Outside a bar magnet, magnetic field lines travel from:
urdu_translation: bar magnet کے outside magnetic field lines کس direction میں travel کرتی ہیں؟
A: South pole to north pole / south pole سے north pole
B: Centre to both poles only / centre سے both poles
C: Random directions / random directions
D: North pole to south pole / north pole سے south pole
correct_answer: D | North pole to south pole / north pole سے south pole

question: Magnetic field lines:
urdu_translation: magnetic field lines کیا کرتی ہیں؟
A: Always cross at right angles / always right angles پر cross کرتی ہیں
B: End in empty space / empty space میں end ہوتی ہیں
C: Have no direction / direction نہیں رکھتیں
D: Never cross one another / کبھی one another کو cross نہیں کرتیں
correct_answer: D | Never cross one another / کبھی one another کو cross نہیں کرتیں

question: A stronger magnetic field is represented by field lines that are:
urdu_translation: stronger magnetic field کو field lines کیسے represent کرتی ہیں؟
A: Farther apart / farther apart
B: Completely absent / completely absent
C: Closer together / closer together
D: Always straight / always straight
correct_answer: C | Closer together / closer together

question: The direction of a magnetic field at a point is shown by:
urdu_translation: point پر magnetic field کی direction کس سے show ہوتی ہے؟
A: The tangent to the field line / field line کی tangent
B: The line perpendicular to every field line / ہر field line کے perpendicular line
C: The mass of the magnet / magnet کی mass
D: The colour of the pole / pole کا colour
correct_answer: A | The tangent to the field line / field line کی tangent

question: A compass needle placed in a magnetic field aligns:
urdu_translation: magnetic field میں placed compass needle کیسے align ہوتی ہے؟
A: Perpendicular to every field line / ہر field line کے perpendicular
B: Along the field direction / field direction کے along
C: Randomly at all times / ہر وقت randomly
D: With the gravitational field only / صرف gravitational field کے ساتھ
correct_answer: B | Along the field direction / field direction کے along

question: A permanent magnet is used in a:
urdu_translation: permanent magnet کس device میں use ہوتی ہے؟
A: Hydraulic press / hydraulic press
B: Mercury barometer / mercury barometer
C: Measuring cylinder / measuring cylinder
D: Moving-coil loudspeaker / moving-coil loudspeaker
correct_answer: D | Moving-coil loudspeaker / moving-coil loudspeaker

question: Permanent magnets can separate:
urdu_translation: permanent magnets کیا separate کر سکتی ہیں؟
A: Iron objects from mixtures / mixtures سے iron objects
B: Water from salt by evaporation / evaporation سے water from salt
C: Heat from temperature / heat from temperature
D: Mass from weight / mass from weight
correct_answer: A | Iron objects from mixtures / mixtures سے iron objects

question: Electromagnets are used in:
urdu_translation: electromagnets کہاں use ہوتی ہیں؟
A: Liquid thermometers / liquid thermometers
B: Electric bells / electric bells
C: Metre rules / metre rules
D: Solar cells / solar cells
correct_answer: B | Electric bells / electric bells

question: An electromagnetic crane is used to lift:
urdu_translation: electromagnetic crane کس چیز کو lift کرنے کے لیے use ہوتی ہے؟
A: Wooden blocks only / صرف wooden blocks
B: Glass sheets only / صرف glass sheets
C: Heavy iron objects / heavy iron objects
D: Water in a pipe / pipe میں water
correct_answer: C | Heavy iron objects / heavy iron objects

question: The magnetic field inside a long current-carrying solenoid is approximately:
urdu_translation: long current-carrying solenoid کے inside magnetic field approximately کیسی ہوتی ہے؟
A: Zero everywhere / everywhere zero
B: Uniform / uniform
C: Circular around a single point only / صرف one point کے around circular
D: Random / random
correct_answer: B | Uniform / uniform

question: A magnetic domain is a group of atoms whose magnetic effects are:
urdu_translation: magnetic domain atoms کا group ہے جس کے magnetic effects کیسے ہوتے ہیں؟
A: Aligned in the same direction / same direction میں aligned
B: Always cancelled individually / individually always cancelled
C: Without electron motion / electron motion کے بغیر
D: Purely gravitational / purely gravitational
correct_answer: A | Aligned in the same direction / same direction میں aligned

question: In an unmagnetised ferromagnetic material, domains are generally:
urdu_translation: unmagnetised ferromagnetic material میں domains generally کیسے ہوتے ہیں؟
A: All aligned in one direction / all one direction میں aligned
B: Absent / absent
C: Electrically charged only / صرف electrically charged
D: Randomly oriented / randomly oriented
correct_answer: D | Randomly oriented / randomly oriented

question: A ferromagnetic material becomes magnetised when its domains:
urdu_translation: ferromagnetic material magnetised کب ہوتی ہے؟
A: Disappear completely / completely disappear ہو جائیں
B: Change into liquid / liquid میں change ہو جائیں
C: Become aligned by an external field / external field سے aligned ہو جائیں
D: Lose all electrons / تمام electrons lose کر دیں
correct_answer: C | Become aligned by an external field / external field سے aligned ہو جائیں

question: In diamagnetic materials, atomic magnetic effects mainly:
urdu_translation: diamagnetic materials میں atomic magnetic effects mainly کیا کرتے ہیں؟
A: Align permanently without a field / field کے بغیر permanently align ہوتے ہیں
B: Produce strong domains naturally / naturally strong domains produce کرتے ہیں
C: Cancel to give nearly zero resultant / cancel ہو کر nearly zero resultant دیتے ہیں
D: Create electric current only / صرف electric current create کرتے ہیں
correct_answer: C | Cancel to give nearly zero resultant / cancel ہو کر nearly zero resultant دیتے ہیں

question: Ferromagnetic materials are suitable for making magnets because they contain:
urdu_translation: ferromagnetic materials magnets بنانے کے لیے suitable کیوں ہیں؟
A: No atomic magnetic effects / no atomic magnetic effects
B: Magnetic domains that can align strongly / magnetic domains جو strongly align ہو سکتے ہیں
C: Only free liquid particles / صرف free liquid particles
D: No electrons / no electrons
correct_answer: B | Magnetic domains that can align strongly / magnetic domains جو strongly align ہو سکتے ہیں

question: A steel bar may be magnetised by:
urdu_translation: steel bar کس method سے magnetised ہو سکتی ہے؟
A: Heating strongly only / صرف strongly heating
B: Stroking with a permanent magnet / permanent magnet سے stroking
C: Hitting repeatedly only / صرف repeatedly hitting
D: Placing in water / water میں placing
correct_answer: B | Stroking with a permanent magnet / permanent magnet سے stroking

question: A strong magnetic field for magnetising steel can be produced by:
urdu_translation: steel کو magnetise کرنے کے لیے strong magnetic field کس سے produce ہوتی ہے؟
A: A measuring cylinder / measuring cylinder
B: A mercury thermometer / mercury thermometer
C: A current-carrying solenoid / current-carrying solenoid
D: A physical balance / physical balance
correct_answer: C | A current-carrying solenoid / current-carrying solenoid

question: A magnet can be demagnetised by:
urdu_translation: magnet کو کس method سے demagnetise کیا جا سکتا ہے؟
A: Heating or hammering / heating یا hammering
B: Stroking correctly with a magnet / magnet سے correctly stroking
C: Keeping it with soft-iron keepers / soft-iron keepers کے ساتھ keeping
D: Cooling at room temperature only / صرف room temperature پر cooling
correct_answer: A | Heating or hammering / heating یا hammering

question: Passing a magnet through a solenoid carrying alternating current tends to:
urdu_translation: alternating current carrying solenoid سے magnet pass کرنے پر کیا ہوتا ہے؟
A: Increase permanent magnetism always / always permanent magnetism increase کرتا ہے
B: Make it electrically charged only / صرف electrically charged بناتا ہے
C: Demagnetise it / اسے demagnetise کرتا ہے
D: Change its mass / اس کی mass change کرتا ہے
correct_answer: C | Demagnetise it / اسے demagnetise کرتا ہے

question: Magnetic recording is used in:
urdu_translation: magnetic recording کہاں use ہوتی ہے؟
A: Mercury thermometers / mercury thermometers
B: Hydraulic brakes / hydraulic brakes
C: Solar water heaters / solar water heaters
D: Audio/video tapes and computer hard disks / audio/video tapes اور computer hard disks
correct_answer: D | Audio/video tapes and computer hard disks / audio/video tapes اور computer hard disks

question: The best material listed for magnetic shielding is:
urdu_translation: magnetic shielding کے لیے listed best material کون سا ہے؟
A: Wood / wood
B: Plastic / plastic
C: Glass / glass
D: Soft iron / soft iron
correct_answer: D | Soft iron / soft iron

question: Soft iron shields a sensitive device mainly by:
urdu_translation: soft iron sensitive device کو mainly کیسے shield کرتا ہے؟
A: Destroying all magnetic fields permanently / تمام magnetic fields permanently destroy کرکے
B: Providing an easier path for magnetic field lines / magnetic field lines کے لیے easier path provide کرکے
C: Increasing electric resistance only / صرف electric resistance increase کرکے
D: Cooling the device / device کو cool کرکے
correct_answer: B | Providing an easier path for magnetic field lines / magnetic field lines کے لیے easier path provide کرکے

question: The magnetic field pattern of a long current-carrying solenoid is most similar to that of a:
urdu_translation: long current-carrying solenoid کا magnetic field pattern کس کے most similar ہے؟
A: Straight non-current-carrying wire / straight non-current-carrying wire
B: Hydraulic piston / hydraulic piston
C: Liquid thermometer / liquid thermometer
D: Bar magnet / bar magnet
correct_answer: D | Bar magnet / bar magnet

question: A material is suitable for a permanent magnet when its domains:
urdu_translation: material permanent magnet کے لیے suitable کب ہے جب اس کے domains کیا کریں؟
A: Immediately return to random directions / immediately random directions میں return کریں
B: Disappear during magnetisation / magnetisation کے دوران disappear ہوں
C: Remain largely aligned after the external field is removed / external field remove ہونے کے بعد largely aligned رہیں
D: Cancel all atomic effects at every stage / ہر stage پر تمام atomic effects cancel کریں
correct_answer: C | Remain largely aligned after the external field is removed / external field remove ہونے کے بعد largely aligned رہیں
